species.tagline: A small shark of Hong Kong waters

tasks.title: See how big it is
tasks.message: This is a small shark — about as tall as you are.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a smooth-hound. It is small — about as long as a child is tall.

tasks.title: What it eats
tasks.message: It hunts crabs and prawns on the seabed, and does not attack people.
tasks.subtitle: Smooth-hounds hunt crabs and prawns on the seabed. They do not attack people.

tasks.title: How to help
tasks.message: A clean seabed is where it finds its food.
tasks.subtitle: A clean seabed with crabs and prawns is where it feeds. Thank you!
